stories.title: Nine terrorists killed in two intelligence-based operations in Balochistan: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed nine terrorists belonging to Indian backed Fitna al-Hindustan during two Intelligence-Based Operations (IBOs) in Balochistan's Kachhi and Wadh districts, the military's media wing said on Wednesday.

stories.brief: Justice Kayani previously served as the senior puisne judge of the IHC and was expecting to be elevated to the post of the high court’s chief justice.

stories.title: Flavio Bolsonaro lands in Miami with his family after Trump offers Brazil exit
stories.brief: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and his family arrived in Miami on Wednesday, where the United States government will grant them entry visas after he refused ​to comply with a Brazilian Supreme Court order to surrender his passports.

stories.title: Karachi hospitals report surge in flu cases as H1N1 strain circulates
stories.brief: Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) reported around 400 cases of influenza, a more dangerous variant of the common flu, this year, with the H1N1 strain infecting residents.

stories.title: Secret to national development lies in AI and digitisation: PM Shehbaz
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said on Wednesday that the secret to national development lay in artificial intelligence (AI) and digitisation, stressing the need to accelerate their adoption across key sectors, including agriculture, trade, healthcare and governance.

stories.title: In support of One-China policy, Pakistan bans Taiwanese airlines from using its airspace: report
stories.brief: He said that Islamabad now only permitted airlines from the People’s Republic of China to fly over Pakistan, excluding Taiwan. According to flight tracking data, Taiwanese carriers began rerouting flights over the weekend, with China Airlines Ltd and Eva Airways Corp no longer flying over Pakistan since Sunday.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz orders urgent reforms in Islamabad's govt schools
stories.brief: According to the PMO, the premier also highlighted third-party validation and the promotion of solarisation in government schools. For disabled or wheelchair-bound students, PM Shehbaz directed the construction of ramps in all government schools, while emphasising that the best medical facilities should be provided.

stories.title: ‘Have no illusions’: Kundi tells Afghan Taliban Pakistan will not tolerate attacks after Angoor Adda firing
stories.brief: The incident took place on Tuesday night when Afghan security forces opened unprovoked fire on Pakistan Army border posts and residential areas in the Angoor Adda border area.

stories.title: K-P governor's rule to end in six months, emergency to continue until peace restored: Tariq Fazal
stories.brief: Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Dr Tariq Fazal Chaudhry said governor's rule in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) would end after six months, while the emergency would remain in place until peace was restored in the province.

stories.title: FM Dar meets MJDA secretary general, underscores defence pact's importance for regional peace
stories.brief: Gen. (R) Nauman Mahmood, HI (M), called on the Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs today. In a statement, the MoFA said the Omani foreign minister thanked Dar for the “gracious hospitality” extended to him during his recent visit to Pakistan.

stories.title: K-P governor warns Afghan Taliban against further aggression towards Pakistan
stories.brief: The remarks came after the Afghan Taliban regime targeted civilian areas in South Waziristan's Angoor Adda along the border, injuring five members of a family and killing one member on Tuesday night.
